subject: Signature orbit: routing & stamp ops for FinTrust DPA
messages:
From: Dorothy Lee <dorothy.lee@fintrust.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: FinTrust DPA — routing preference and e-sign logistics

Ben / Marissa,

Thanks for sending the updated DPA redlines. Legal has reviewed and we can proceed to e-sign, but we want to confirm the execution lane so we get the envelope routing right in DocuSign. Our preferred sequence is: FinTrust CFO -> FinTrust Legal (in-house) -> Redwood countersign.

Two asks from our side:
- Please confirm the Redwood authorized signer (name + title) who will be the final recipient.
- Can Redwood accept an envelope with a conditional recipient (countersign only after FinTrust Legal signs)?

I attached FinTrust_DPA_redlines_v2.pdf with our final comments. If you can share Redwood's routing instructions, we can pre-configure recipients and expiry.

We'd like to complete signatures by EOD 2028-04-03 to align with our procurement window.

Best,
Dorothy Lee
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
FinTrust Inc.
Attachment: FinTrust_DPA_redlines_v2.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dorothy Lee <dorothy.lee@fintrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust DPA — routing preference and e-sign logistics

Dorothy — thanks. Quick answers:
1) Redwood authorized signer: David Kim, Head of Legal Operations (david_kim@redwood.com). He is the countersigner for DPAs with procurement limits above our self-serve threshold.
2) We can accept a conditional recipient. DocuSign supports recipient routing order with an "auto-advance" set to off for the last recipient; we use that for manual countersign in edge cases.

I'll loop in David and share the routing doc we use internally (Routing-Instructions.pdf). Once David confirms role + whether he needs a wet signature exception, you can send the envelope.

Also: is procurement sending the envelope from a shared FinTrust account or from an individual (CFO) email? We prefer an envelope that lists the CFO as signer and procurement as cc.

Thanks — I want to keep the SLA you suggested.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: FinTrust DPA — routing preference and e-sign logistics

David — forwarding FinTrust's ask. Ben says you're the authorized countersigner on DPAs in this band. Two quick operational checks:
- Do you need the final PDF with signature tabs, or will you sign directly in DocuSign?
- Do you want to be recipient role "Redwood Countersign" with ID verification?

We also have a small redline left in Clause 7.3 re: subprocessor notifications that FinTrust flagged — they asked us about an escrow / subprocessor disclosure cadence. Would you like procurement to handle that thread or should Legal respond directly?

Marissa Cole
Sales Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Dorothy Lee <dorothy.lee@fintrust.com>, procurement@fintrust.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust DPA — routing preference and e-sign logistics

Dorothy / procurement team —

Thanks for the clear routing. Confirming: I will be the Redwood countersigner (Head of Legal Operations). Please set recipient order as follows in the DocuSign envelope:
1) CFO <cfo@fintrust.com> — Signer (Order 1)
2) FinTrust Legal (in-house counsel) — Signer (Order 2)
3) David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com> — Signer (Order 3, countersign).

Security & verification: we request ID check on the CFO recipient and that the envelope uses DocuSign's standard audit trail (we will keep it for our records). Please disable automatic final auto-advance for my recipient so I can review the executed PDF before countersigning.

On the remaining subprocessor clause — Legal is fine with the current language but requests a short note in the envelope comments referencing our subprocessor list URL (we track changes via a monthly notice). If FinTrust needs an escrow-style attestation, please attach the subprocessor snapshot (we've attached Routing-Instructions.pdf with the checkbox template we use).

DocuSign envelope: once the envelope is created, please share the envelope ID and a link so we can add our internal envelope watcher and schedule status checks (daily). Suggested target completion: 2028-04-03.

Attachments: Routing-Instructions.pdf (internal routing checklist)

Regards,
David Kim
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Dorothy Lee <dorothy.lee@fintrust.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@fintrust.com
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTrust DPA — routing preference and e-sign logistics

David — perfect, thank you. We created the envelope with the recipient order you specified and enabled ID verification for the CFO. Envelope details below:
- Envelope ID: FT-8927-ENVELOPE
- Link: https://app.docusign.com/envelopes/FT-8927-ENVELOPE
- Attachments: FinTrust_DPA_redlines_v2.pdf (with final callouts)

Note on subprocessors: procurement wants the monthly disclosure cadence captured in the DocuSign comments; we'll include a short attestation and a link to our subprocessor list. If Redwood needs a separate signed attestation, let us know — otherwise the comments will suffice.

We're sending to the CFO now. We'll push daily status updates to this thread and share the envelope log (envelope-log-FT8927.txt) once the CFO signs.

Thanks all,
Dorothy Lee
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
FinTrust Inc.
